purpose: Predeclared before any v2 song is captured or scored (VGT-7, PR #33): the second held-out batch (v2) of McGill Billboard 2.0.1 songs with no known BTC training-song overlap, for scoring Vibe Guitar auto charts against public, time-aligned chord annotations. Songs: the frozen v1 pool and order (docs/annotation-heldout-v1-pool.json) from rank 33 (v1's amended stop was rank 32), upload rule amended-v1 exactly as in PR #31, recomputed from the raw results of docs/annotation-heldout-v1-search-log.json (no new search; that log's not-needed marks are not decisions); songs without a qualifying upload are skipped and the walk stops at the first N = 46 with one. Size: k = 13 v1 songs in PR #31's primary mean under PR #32's evaluator; N = 46 is the smallest N with P(X >= 15) >= 0.95 for X ~ BetaBinomial(N, 14, 13) (P = 0.9555); planning for the count condition only. Capture as frozen in PR #33: list order, a build of main after PR #33; a technical failure (no chart, or a chart covering less than 90% of the upload) is retried up to 2 more times before any v2 scoring, then the song is missing; no song is ever replaced and N stays the denominator. Analysis: PR #31's analysis on v2 alone (unweighted mean of per-song majmin WCSR, percentile bootstrap 95% interval over songs, 10 000 resamples, mulberry32 seed 7007), never pooled with v1 or the earlier lists. Results never change the list: no redraw, no replacement or addition.

billboard-2.0.1-lab.name: McGill Billboard 2.0 (2.0.1 LAB files; chords only, no beats)
billboard-2.0.1-lab.licenceQuote: we have made them available legally under a CC0 license, but we ask that users follow scholarly norms in any public-facing work based on upon these data by citing the following ISMIR paper
billboard-2.0.1-lab.attribution: John Ashley Burgoyne, Jonathan Wild, and Ichiro Fujinaga, 'An Expert Ground Truth Set for Audio Chord Recognition and Music Analysis', in Proceedings of the 12th International Society for Music Information Retrieval Conference (Miami, FL, 2011), pp. 633-38.
billboard-2.0.1-lab.btcTraining: Not listed in the BTC README. The chosen songs were also checked against the UsPop2002 annotation list BTC used (github.com/tmc323/Chord-Annotations, uspopLabels, 195 songs): no title match. Two Billboard candidates that are in that list (Michael Jackson 'Beat It', Billy Joel 'Just the Way You Are') were left out.
